2608.26036.title: Trace Integrity for LLM Data Agents: A Vision for Auditable Structured Reasoning in Real-World Systems
2608.26036.paper_summary: Answer accuracy is an insufficient reliability signal for LLM data agents. In structured-data tasks, a benchmark-correct answer can be produced by an invalid trace. This paper introduces Trace Integrity, a deployment reliability criterion for evaluating whether the computation recorded behind an answer is explicit, executable, schema-valid, operator-faithful, replayable, answer-consistent, and auditable. We identify the Structure Gap as the deployment failure mode that makes Trace Integrity necessary: natural-language reasoning and free-form rationales do not reliably specify the operator-level programs required by real-world systems. We operationalize Trace Integrity with execution contracts, structured artifacts that bind user intent to schema elements, operator plans, assumptions, executable queries, verification status, and final-answer linkage. We also introduce CAIT (Correct Answer / Invalid Trace) Rate, which measures how often answer-only evaluation counts computationally unsupported outputs as successes. In an empirical demonstration on BIRD Mini-Dev, Direct SQL, Operation Summary + SQL, and Contract-First SQL achieve answer accuracies of 20%, 22%, and 24%, while their Trace Integrity Pass Rates are 39%, 43%, and 40% and their CAIT Rates remain high at 55%, 59.1%, and 45.8%, showing that answer accuracy, trace validity, and silent-failure risk are distinct evaluation signals. Real-world LLM data agents should, therefore, be evaluated not only by whether their outputs match a reference answer, but by whether those outputs are backed by auditable computation.
2608.26036.paper_summary_zh: 回答的準確性對於 LLM 數據代理來說是一個不足的可靠性信號。<lb/>在結構化數據任務中，基準正確答案可能是由無效的追蹤產生的。<lb/>本文介紹了追蹤完整性，這是一種部署可靠性標準，用於評估記錄在答案背後的計算是否是明確的、可執行的、符合結構的、忠實於運算符的、可重播的、一致的答案和可審計的。<lb/>我們將結構差距確定為使追蹤完整性變得必要的部署失敗模式：自然語言推理和自由形式的理由並不能可靠地指定現實世界系統所需的運算符級程序。<lb/>我們通過執行合約來具體化追蹤完整性，這是一種結構化的工件，將用戶意圖與結構元素、運算符計劃、假設、可執行查詢、驗證狀態和最終答案鏈接綁定在一起。<lb/>我們還介紹了 CAIT（正確答案 / 無效追蹤）率，該指標衡量僅依賴答案評估的情況下，計算上不支持的輸出被計算為成功的頻率。在對 BIRD Mini-Dev 的實證演示中，直接 SQL、操作摘要 + SQL 和合約優先 SQL 的答案準確率分別為 20%、22% 和 24%，而它們的追蹤完整性通過率分別為 39%、43% 和 40%，CAIT 率仍然保持在 55%、59.1% 和 45.8% 的高水平，顯示出答案準確性、追蹤有效性和靜默失敗風險是不同的評估信號。因此，現實世界中的 LLM 數據代理應該不僅僅根據其輸出是否與參考答案匹配來評估，而應根據這些輸出是否有可審計的計算支持來評估。
